units.name: UpdateDmcSample
units.summary: Per-frame DMC request logic. A new request (DmcId bit 7 clear) copies sample DmcId-$1E's register record from DmcSampleTable (bank 2) into the DMC entries of SfxRegs, reserves the DMC for DmcRepeatTable[sample] updates (SfxChannelBusy+4) and marks the request started. Afterwards that reservation counts down; at zero DmcId becomes $9E (sample $1E, the silent loop, already started).
